arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT "booking" AS kind, json_object("booking_id",b.booking_id,"request_id",b.request_id,"flight_id",b.flight_id,"passenger_id",b.passenger_id,"amount_cents",b.amount_cents,"status",b.status,"client_reference",b.client_reference,"charges",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("charge_id",c.charge_id,"key",c.idempotency_key,"amount",c.amount_cents,"state",c.state,"created_step",c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),"cancel",(SELECT json_group_array(json_object("event_id",e.event_id,"step",e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status="pending" UNION ALL SELECT "outbox",json_object("event_id",event_id,"booking_id",booking_id,"payload",payload,"attempts",attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status="pending" UNION ALL SELECT "cache",json_object("key",key,"value",value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT "flight",json_object("id",flight_id,"capacity",capacity,"price",price_cents,"version",version) FROM flights

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights

SELECT 'booking' AS kind,json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'hold',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight',h.flight_id,'passenger',h.passenger_id)) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id),'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event',e.event_id,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'log',json_object('id',id,'service',service,'path',path,'status',status,'trace',trace_id,'message',message) FROM request_logs WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM request_logs WHERE service='payment' AND (status<>200 OR message NOT LIKE '%captur%') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 30) UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'incomplete_confirmations' AS check_name,COUNT(*) AS violations FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id AND h.flight_id=b.flight_id AND h.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND c.amount_cents=b.amount_cents)<>1 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id AND k.flight_id=b.flight_id AND k.passenger_id=b.passenger_id) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_residuals',COUNT(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins k WHERE k.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id AND c.state='captured' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.charge_id=c.charge_id AND r.booking_id=b.booking_id AND r.amount_cents=c.amount_cents))) UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_sales',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING COUNT(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'duplicate_charges',COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT booking_id FROM charges WHERE state='captured' GROUP BY booking_id HAVING COUNT(*)>1) UNION ALL SELECT 'cancelled_requests_confirmed',COUNT(*) FROM bookings b JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'oversold_flights',COUNT(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_or_wrong_charge',COUNT(*) FROM charges c LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=c.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR c.amount_cents<>b.amount_cents UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_refunds',COUNT(*) FROM refunds r LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id WHERE b.booking_id IS NULL OR b.status<>'cancelled' UNION ALL SELECT 'unresolved_bookings',COUNT(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'pending_events',COUNT(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
